ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Rust Chrome
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
A rusted-iron-and-brass UI skin for the whole game, generic to any RimWorld game (no campaign names anywhere in it) - per design/Jawa/worldbuilding/ui_appearance_spec.md section 3.
Tier 1 (texture override, no C#): 14 loose PNGs at the vanilla UI paths - UI/Widgets/ButtonBG, ButtonBGMouseover, ButtonBGClick, ButtonSubtleAtlas, TabAtlas, DesButBG, AbilityButBG, CheckOn, CheckOff, CheckPartial, RadioButOn, RadioButOff, and UI/Buttons/SliderRail, SliderHandle. Every atlas keeps the vanilla file's exact pixel dimensions and alpha/silhouette layout (measured from the game's own RimWorldWin64_Data/resources.assets, never guessed) - only the colour changed, via a per-pixel luminance-to-palette remap that preserves every bevel, border and vignette already baked into the source art. ContentFinder's last-mod-wins walk picks these up with zero patches, zero Harmony, as long as this mod loads after every other retexture.
Tier 2 (cheap C#): a ~40-line [StaticConstructorOnStartup] class (RimMandrake.RustChrome.RustChromeColors) that reflection-sets Widgets' window/section/option colour fields and InspectPaneUtility's tab-fill texture once at startup - a field set, not a Harmony patch, touching no draw code. Every field name was verified against decompiled Verse.Widgets and RimWorld.InspectPaneUtility before writing the reflection code.
Load this mod LAST so its textures win ContentFinder's walk.
